name: io.github.Poket-Jony/cookidough-mcp
title: Cookidough (unofficial Thermomix Cookidoo)
description: Search, plan, shop and upload guided-cooking recipes on the Thermomix Cookidoo platform

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOUGH_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Account email (phone number for the mainland-China platform)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOUGH_QUALITY_BAR
environmentVariables.description: Minimum recipe quality score for uploads (default: 70)

environmentVariables.name: COOKIDOUGH_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to persist the OAuth2 tokens across restarts
